spans.s:
Pedu is the name in the Rigveda of a protégé of the Aśvins, who gave him, in order, as it seems, to replace a bad steed, a mythical horse, hence called paidva, which probably represents the horse of the sun.
Foot notes Rv. i. 117, 9; 118, 9; 119, 10; vii. 71, 5; x. 39, 10.
Rv. ix. 88, 4; Av. x. 4, 5 et seq.
Macdonell, Vedic Mythology, pp. 52, 149.
